styles.name: Neo Pastel Atelier
styles.description: Soft pastel gradients with clean silhouettes, inspired by boutique designer studios. Focuses on gentle light transitions and polished, friendly character forms.
styles.colorPalette: Powder blue, blush peach, lavender haze, ivory highlights.

styles.name: Techno Prism Core
styles.description: High-contrast futuristic style mixing chrome planes with transparent prisms. Echoes hi-fi electronics and kinetic architecture.
styles.colorPalette: Mirror silver, electric cyan, ultraviolet accents, matte charcoal.

styles.name: Heritage Craft Revival
styles.description: Combines traditional motifs with contemporary minimalism. Uses embroidery-like patterns, carved reliefs, and muted earthy pigments.
styles.colorPalette: Oxblood red, indigo, aged gold, warm ivory.

styles.name: Bio-Mech Harmony
styles.description: Organic vines interwoven with mechanical structures. Balances matte armor plates with living textures for a collectible, high-detail finish.
styles.colorPalette: Deep forest green, bone white, graphite black, neon sap green.

styles.name: Playful Bold Block
styles.description: Chunky block-out aesthetics with strong color blocking and toyetic geometry. Evokes street culture and graphic art.
styles.colorPalette: Signal yellow, cyan, magenta, deep black outlines.

materials.name: Soft Vinyl Skin
materials.whenToUse: Flexible outer shell for approachable characters and rounded silhouettes.
materials.notes: Supports airbrushed gradients and pad-printed details.

materials.name: Clear Resin Core
materials.whenToUse: Showcases inner structures or glowing effects with suspended particles.
materials.notes: Pair with embedded glitter or pigment clouds for depth.

materials.name: Mirror Chrome Plating
materials.whenToUse: Highlight mechanical parts, helmets, or accessories that need futuristic sheen.
materials.notes: Requires clean geometry; combine with matte surfaces for contrast.

materials.name: ABS Structural Armature
materials.whenToUse: Internal skeletons and articulated joints requiring rigidity.
materials.notes: Allows modular limb swapping and stability.

materials.name: Porcelain Shell
materials.notes: Supports hand-painted motifs and etched relief.

materials.name: Bio Resin Overgrowth
materials.whenToUse: Simulate plant or coral structures merging with armor.
materials.notes: Works with dry brushing and weathering powders.

materials.name: Matte PU Coating
materials.whenToUse: Surface sealing for bold color blocks and tactile feel.

materials.name: Diffused LED Module
materials.whenToUse: Add controlled lighting to transparent cores or visors.
materials.notes: Use with translucent resin and frosted surfaces to avoid hotspots.

materials.name: Hand Brush Glaze
materials.whenToUse: Traditional motifs requiring visible brush strokes and depth.
materials.notes: Pairs well with porcelain shells or carved wood inlay.

materials.name: Engraved Wood Inlay
materials.whenToUse: Accents for heritage or eco-inspired designs.
materials.notes: Use laser-etched motifs or embedded panels.

materials.name: Weathering Powder Finish
materials.whenToUse: Add depth to armor edges and organic-mech transitions.
materials.notes: Fix with clear matte sealant to prevent transfer.

crafts.name: Gradual Airbrush Gradient
crafts.effect: Creates smooth color transitions for cheeks, limbs, and accessories.

crafts.name: Panel Line Wash
crafts.effect: Accentuates grooves and panel divisions with controlled ink wash.

crafts.name: Foil Hot Stamp
crafts.effect: Applies metallic foil accents with crisp edges.

crafts.name: Micro Embroidery Pad Print
crafts.effect: Simulates stitched surfaces with multi-layer pad printing.
